content.text: {"id": "mm7142a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "2-dose monovalent mRNA COVID-19 vaccine VE against COVID-19–associated hospitalization during Omicron predominance was 36%"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among SARS-CoV-2 test-positive case-patients, 1,815 (36.3%), 1,387 (27.7%), 1,552 (31.0%)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among SARS-CoV-2 test-positive case-patients, 1,815 (36.3%), 1,387 (27.7%), 1,552 (31.0%)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE was estimated using a test-negative design, comparing the odds of being vaccinated versus unvaccinated"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "When stratified by sublineage period, VE was higher ≥7 days after receipt of dose 3 during the BA.1 period"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "test-negative", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "using a test-negative design comparing odds of previous vaccination among persons with a positive or negative molecular test result"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE was higher ≥7 days after receipt of dose 3 during the BA.1 period (67%; median interval since vaccination = 99 days)"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Multivariable logistic regression models were adjusted for age, geographic region"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "weighted for the inverse propensity to be vaccinated or unvaccinated"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Estimates with nonoverlapping 95% CIs were considered significantly different."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "VE was calculated as ([1 − odds ratio] x 100%)"}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Generalized boosted regression trees were used to estimate the propensity to be vaccinated"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
